assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated
The long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is coded as CPT 93247
The study is intended to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other dysrhythmias
The clinical indication is documented in the clinical indication note
The symptom code R42 is used for dizziness/giddiness
